message.touhou_maid_eat_properly.food_pe: You can mark at most 8 containers

message.touhou_maid_eat_properly.bound_l: This lunchbox doesn't seem to be meant for her...
message.touhou_maid_eat_properly.lunchbo: Master, I can't free my hands to eat!
message.touhou_maid_eat_properly.extra_m: There's not a single dish on the menu—I can't add an extra meal!

item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.thanks_not: Empty Treat Box with a Thanks Note
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.paired_cup: One of a Pair of Cups
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.forget_me_: A small bouquet of forget-me-nots from %s.
A faint, serene fragrance drifts between the sky-blue petals.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.praise_cer: "Awarded to: Master | Issued by: %s | For attentive care, timely feeding, and being the best caretaker this week (and every day)."
The seal is crooked, but it was stamped with determination.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.thanks_not: A note rests in the elegant empty box: "Thank you, Master! —%s"
A trace of sweetness still lingers inside.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.paper_cran: Its wings are a little rumpled; perhaps she got lost in a happy thought.
%s's mealtime bell. Give it a ring and she will come.
Tiny letters on it read: "Time to eat—"
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.thanks_can: "This is %s's favorite candy... but you can have it, Master!"
It looks as though she treasured it for ages... surely it has not expired?
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.crumpled_c: This wrapper once held a candy filled with %s's feelings.
The happiness from eating it still seems to linger in your heart.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.half_straw: Asked where the other half went, her eyes—and ears—become suspiciously restless.
"Master, thank you for always taking care of me. I meant to give you the whole cake... but I could not resist eating half. Hehe. I hope every day brings you joy~"
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.field_phot: A field landscape photo from %s—soft grass beneath a distant sky.
A corner of her sleeve peeks into frame—she wanted to share half of "the scenery that feels as safe as every ordinary day."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.banner_hon: Six bold words fill the banner: A Truly Conscientious Master. Respectfully presented by %s.
She looked utterly solemn while presenting it, though her tail would not stop wagging.
A softly glowing gem %s pressed into your hand. "This is... how I feel. Please keep it safe, Master."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.handwritte: Hello. I was a little nervous writing this—my tail tied itself in knots (or tried to).
Thank you for remembering my hungry stomach, and for letting me trouble you. With you here, every day feels a little brighter.
Please keep looking after me—and eat properly. I promise I will always be here too.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.moonlight_: A moonlight shard from %s—a faintly glowing crystal flake.
"Like a tiny crumb that fell from the moon... for you, Master, so the night never feels lonely."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.two_tone_h: A two-tone hair tie chosen by %s. "If Master wears it, I can spot you from far away."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.embroidere: A tiny flower is embroidered in one corner of the white handkerchief — stitch by stitch, it feels like %s's care.
She insisted: "Bring it to me when it gets dirty. I will wash it for you, Master."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.paired_cup: One of a pair of cups from %s; she kept the other:
"That means... we are a pair now."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.unopened_s: A still-wrapped souvenir prepared by %s. "What is inside? Hmm... open it and see!"
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.pressed_di: A page pressed with a small flower reads: "Master took such good care of me again today." Signed: %s
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.block_figu: A tiny model assembled by %s. It leans a little, but she presented it with great ceremony.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.silver_bel: %s's silver bell. "It will chime softly when you walk... then I will know you are nearby."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.warm_amule: An amulet from %s; it remains warm against your skin.
"I want you to keep taking care of me... and I want to keep taking care of you."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.eternal_me: The ticket reads: Unlimited uses / Valid only for Master. Issued by: %s.
"It cannot really buy a meal... I just want there always to be a next time we eat together."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.heart_knot: A red cord tied tightly by %s.
"Now we can never part—just kidding. But... I truly hope we never do."
A sugar jar from %s. She treasured it for a long time, yet gave it to you in the end.
"Sweet things should be shared with the most important person."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.unnamed_ri: A plain ring from %s; she pushes the box toward you:
"If you wish, Master... wear it. You understand what I mean, right?"
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.plain_pouc: A small pouch from %s, with fine, close stitches.
"There is nothing valuable inside—only the feeling that I want to see you every day."
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.bound_lunc: %s's name is written inside the lid. A lunchbox reserved just for her.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.extra_meal: A crumpled permit reading "I want to eat now!" Use it on a maid to start or refresh her request.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.hypnosis_n: A purple note covered in spirals. "What did I want to eat...?" Applying it makes her forget the current order for a while.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.heart_seas: Restores a little extra satiety whenever the wearer eats.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.insulated_: Slows the wearer's natural satiety loss.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.moon_apple: A moonlit candy that slowly restores the wearer's satiety.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.scarlet_am: Increases the wearer's maximum health by 10%.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.night_spar: Grants the wearer continuous night vision.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.sweet_soft: Grants brief absorption whenever the wearer eats.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.sobering_r: Reduces the duration of negative effects on the wearer.
item.touhou_maid_eat_properly.lake_fairy: Makes fairy maids neutral toward the wearer.
gui.touhou_maid_eat_properly.request_for: %s seems to have forgotten what she wanted…
